question:
**Direction: Select the synonym of the word ‘reproduce’ from the sentence.**

Many scientific researches have proved that DNA replicates itself in the human body and is an enzyme based catalyst reaction.
solution:
The correct answer is "Replicates."
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The word "reproduce" means to produce a copy of something. (किसी की नक़ल बनाना, किसी को पुनः बनाना)
